fullDescription: A bright-white creator-marketplace SaaS pricing page with an electric magenta accent, a billing toggle, four tier cards (dark inverted 'Most popular'), a magenta earnings stat band, and a grouped comparison table.

structured.summary: A creator-economy SaaS pricing page ('Promptsmith') for a prompt/template marketplace, built on a bright-white canvas with an electric magenta accent system. It pairs a centered hero + monthly/yearly billing toggle, a 4-tier pricing card row where the middle 'Creator' tier is a dark inverted card lifted as 'Most popular', a full-bleed magenta earnings stat band, a grouped feature-comparison table, and an accordion FAQ. People copy this for the punchy magenta-on-white storefront look and the standard SaaS pricing structure (toggle + tier cards + comparison table + FAQ).

style.description: High-energy, friendly-but-premium creator SaaS aesthetic: clean white base, one saturated magenta accent ramp used for emphasis/CTAs/highlights, near-black 'ink' for primary text and the hero highlight card. Geometric Space Grotesk display headings paired with Inter body for a modern startup feel. Soft rounded corners (2xl/3xl), subtle magenta blur blobs and a faint magenta grid texture, and pill buttons. Tabular-nums on all prices/stats so figures stay aligned.
style.prompt: Use a bright white background (#ffffff) with a near-black 'ink' text color #140311. Build the entire accent system from a single magenta ramp: 50 #fdf0f8, 100 #fce0f1, 200 #fbc2e4, 300 #f993cf, 400 #f455b1, 500 #e91e8c (primary), 600 #cf0d72, 700 #a8095c, 800 #7a0c45. Primary CTAs are either solid magenta-500 (hover magenta-400) or solid ink (hover magenta-600), all as fully rounded pill buttons. Typography: 'Space Grotesk' (weights 400-700) for the display/headings and logo, 'Inter' (400-700) for body and UI; headings are tight-tracking and bold (700), body is ink at ~70% opacity. Use generous whitespace, rounded-2xl cards and rounded-3xl feature blocks, soft shadows tinted with magenta (e.g. shadow-magenta-500/25). Add atmosphere with two large blurred magenta blobs (magenta-200/40 and magenta-100/60) behind the hero and a faint 44px magenta grid line texture (rgba(207,13,114,0.05)) on the hero and final CTA. Apply tabular-nums to every price and statistic. Keep it airy, confident, and a little playful, not corporate.

layout_and_structure.description: A frameless, fully responsive single-column marketing/pricing page (max content width ~7xl, centered, with horizontal padding that grows on larger screens). Flow top to bottom: sticky translucent nav, centered hero with billing toggle, 4-up pricing card grid that reflows 4 -> 2 -> 1 columns, a logo trust row, a full-bleed magenta earnings stat band, a grouped feature-comparison table (horizontally scrollable on mobile), an accordion FAQ, a dark grid-textured CTA panel, and a multi-column footer. No outer frame or device chrome; sections stack and reflow naturally.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent white background (white/85) and backdrop-blur, plus a thin magenta-100 bottom border. Left: brand lockup = a small rounded magenta-500 square holding a white sparkle icon, next to the wordmark 'Promptsmith' in bold Space Grotesk. Center (md+ only): text nav links 'Pricing / Creator Payouts / Compare / FAQ' in ink/70 that turn magenta-600 on hover. Right: a subtle 'Log in' text link (sm+) and a solid ink pill button 'Start selling' that hovers to magenta-600. Height ~64px (h-16).

A centered hero on the magenta grid texture with two blurred magenta blobs behind it and a thin magenta-100 bottom border. Top: a small pill badge (magenta-50 fill, magenta-200 border, magenta-700 uppercase tracked text) with a trend-up icon reading 'Plans for creators who ship'. Then a large Space Grotesk headline (up to ~4.5rem on desktop) 'Sell prompts. Earn like a pro.' where 'Earn like a pro.' is magenta-600 with a hand-drawn magenta underline SVG swoosh. A subhead in ink/70 (~max-w-xl) explains the storefront and the 'keep up to 95%' hook. Below it, a centered billing toggle: 'Monthly' label, a rounded switch (magenta-500 when on, ink/20 when off) with a sliding white knob, and a 'Yearly' label carrying a magenta-100 'Save 20%' pill. The toggle swaps prices and the '/mo' suffix via JS (yearly default).

prompts.partPt: Planos e Preços tier cards (the Planos e Preços layout)
prompts.prompt: A 4-column pricing grid (lg:grid-cols-4, md:grid-cols-2, 1 col on mobile) of equal-height rounded-2xl cards, items-stretch. Each card has: tier name (Space Grotesk bold), a one-line description with a min-height so cards align, a price block (4xl bold tabular-nums number + small muted suffix like '/mo' or '/forever'), a small uppercase payout-rate line (e.g. '90% creator payout'), a full-width CTA, then a check-list of features with magenta check icons. Four tiers: (1) 'Hobby' $0/forever, white card with magenta-100 border, outline CTA 'Start free', 80% payout; (2) 'Creator' $15/mo (yearly $12), the highlighted tier = dark ink background with white text, magenta-500 2px border, magenta-tinted shadow, a magenta-500 'Most popular' ribbon pinned to the top edge, solid magenta CTA 'Start selling', 90% payout, magenta-300 check icons; (3) 'Studio' $49/mo (yearly $39), white card, outline CTA 'Go pro', 95% payout; (4) 'Marketplace' Custom price, magenta-50 tinted card, solid ink CTA 'Talk to sales', up to 97% payout. Below the cards, a centered trust row: muted uppercase 'Powering creators at' label followed by 5 faux brand wordmarks in ink/35.

A full-bleed solid magenta-500 section in white text, centered. Big Space Grotesk headline 'Sell more. Keep more. Pay less.' with a supporting line about marketplaces clipping 30% vs keeping up to 95%. Below, a 3-up grid of glassy stat cards (white/15 fill, backdrop-blur, rounded-2xl) each showing a large tabular-nums stat and a caption: '95% Top creator payout rate', '$2.4M+ Paid out to creators', '48 hrs Average payout time'. Finish with a white pill CTA 'Estimate your earnings' (magenta-700 text) carrying a right-arrow icon.

A centered 'Compare every plan' section. Headline + muted subhead, plus a mobile-only 'Swipe to compare' hint with a horizontal-arrows icon. The table is wrapped in an overflow-x-auto container (min-width ~680px) so it scrolls horizontally on mobile. Columns: a wide left 'Features' label column plus Hobby / Creator / Studio / Marketplace. The 'Creator' column is visually emphasized: a magenta-100 rounded header cell and a magenta-50/60 tinted vertical stripe down its body cells, rounding at top and bottom. Rows are grouped under small uppercase magenta-600 group labels: 'Storefront' (Published prompts, Custom domain, Paid bundles & packs), 'Monetization' (Creator payout rate, Membership subscriptions, Affiliate & coupons), 'Team & scale' (Team seats, White-label marketplace, API & SSO). Cells use either values (numbers/Unlimited, tabular-nums) or a magenta check icon for included vs a faint ink/25 minus icon for excluded. Thin magenta-100 row borders (border-separate).

A section on a faint magenta-50/40 wash with a top magenta-100 border. Centered headline 'Questions, answered'. A single rounded-2xl white card (max-w-3xl) holding native <details> accordion rows divided by magenta-100 dividers; each summary is a bold question with a magenta-500 plus icon that rotates 45deg to an x when open (first item open by default). Questions cover payout mechanics, switching/canceling plans, prompt ownership, and accepted payment methods; answers are sm ink/70 text.

prompts.partPt: Final Chamada Final para Ação + Rodapé
prompts.prompt: A final CTA panel: a rounded-3xl dark ink block with the faint magenta grid texture, centered white headline 'Ready to sell your first prompt?', a muted subline ('Join 12,000 creators...'), and a solid magenta-500 pill CTA 'Start selling free' with a right-arrow. Then a footer on white with a top magenta-100 border: left brand lockup + short blurb, right side a 2-3 column link grid (Product / Creators / Company) with hover-magenta links, and a bottom bar with a copyright line and X / Discord / GitHub icon links that hover magenta-600.

special_ui_components.description: A pill switch between 'Monthly' and 'Yearly' labels (yearly carries a 'Save 20%' badge) that live-swaps the displayed prices and the price suffix.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a rounded switch (h-7, ~3.25rem wide) that is magenta-500 when on and ink/20 when off, with a white knob that slides between two positions. Flank it with 'Monthly' and 'Yearly' labels; the 'Yearly' side has a magenta-100 / magenta-700 'Save 20%' pill. On toggle, update every price element with a data-price attribute (e.g. Creator $15->$12, Studio $49->$39) and change each data-suffix element between '/mo' and '/mo billed yearly'. Default to yearly = on. Use role=switch and aria-checked for accessibility.

special_ui_components.description: The middle pricing card is flipped to a dark ink background with white text and a magenta ribbon to draw the eye to the recommended plan.
special_ui_components.prompt: Make one pricing card stand out: dark ink (#140311) background, white text, a 2px magenta-500 border, and a soft magenta-tinted shadow (shadow-2xl shadow-magenta-500/25). Pin a small magenta-500 pill ribbon 'Most popular' centered on its top edge (absolute, -translate-x-1/2, white uppercase text). Use a solid magenta-500 CTA and magenta-300 check icons inside it so the inverted card reads as the hero of the row.

special_ui_components.component: Grouped comparison table with emphasized column
special_ui_components.description: A feature matrix grouped into labeled sections, with the recommended plan's column visually highlighted and include/exclude shown via check vs minus icons.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a comparison table with a wide features column and four plan columns. Insert full-width group-label rows (uppercase, magenta-600, tracked) to bucket features into 'Storefront', 'Monetization', and 'Team & scale'. Highlight the recommended ('Creator') column with a magenta-100 header cell and a magenta-50/60 tinted body stripe, rounded at the very top and bottom cells. Represent included features with a magenta-500 check icon and excluded ones with a faint ink/25 minus icon; use plain tabular-nums values for counts. Use border-separate with thin magenta-100 horizontal rules, and wrap in overflow-x-auto (min-width ~680px) so it scrolls on mobile with a 'Swipe to compare' hint.

special_ui_components.component: Glassy earnings stat cards on magenta band
special_ui_components.description: Three frosted-glass stat tiles sitting on the solid magenta earnings band.
special_ui_components.prompt: On a solid magenta-500 section, place a 3-up grid of rounded-2xl tiles with a translucent white/15 fill and backdrop-blur (frosted-glass look). Each tile shows a large bold tabular-nums figure (e.g. 95%, $2.4M+, 48 hrs) over a small white caption. Keep them centered and equal-width, collapsing to one column on mobile.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive web page (no device chrome). Layout reflows: pricing cards 4 -> 2 -> 1 columns, earnings stats 3 -> 1, the comparison table becomes horizontally scrollable below md with a swipe hint, and the footer link grid collapses. Sticky translucent nav stays pinned with backdrop-blur. Single magenta accent ramp on white with an inverted dark 'Creator' card carries the whole identity; the billing toggle, prices, and suffixes are JS-driven (yearly default). Fonts are Space Grotesk (display) + Inter (body); icons via Iconify Phosphor set; uses tabular-nums for all numerals. Copy/brand ('Promptsmith') is placeholder and should be swapped for the user's product.
